detail.longDescription: If I have a # docker container on vlan 1, and I want to reach it from vlan 2, you'd think I just need to open the docker container's port on the firewall. But that doesn't work. I've tried adding the rule on both vlan 1 and vlan 2. I wonder if there's something weird with # pfSense . I also tried NAT rules. What's weird is it used to be able to connect. But then stopped randomly. Maybe the latest # Ubuntu broke something.
